Dialogs.Dialog: ▲主人公＊▲. Um, I have a favor to ask.
▲新主人公▲... would it be bad if I called you that？
Sure, that's fine. Call me that.
Phew. It was embarrassing, but I'm glad I worked up the courage▼
Hmm, I think I'd like a different name...
▲主人公＊▲. This one's nice too, right？
Isn't it fine the way it is now？
(The way it is now is best！)
I'm going to call you this from now on, okay？
Sure, that's fine. Call me that.
Hehe. I like how you go along with what I say like that, you know？
Hmm, I think I'd like a different name...
Isn't it fine the way it is now？
Geez, and I worked up the nerve to bring it up.
(The way it is now is best！)
Would you be happy if I called you ▲新主人公▲？
Sure, that's fine. Call me that.
Really？ Then I'll call you that.
Hmm, I think I'd like a different name...
Okay. Then from now on I'll call you that？
Isn't it fine the way it is now？
(The way it is now is best！)
It's really embarrassing, but I thought you'd be happy.
(Since I've got the chance, let me go for it...)
▲主人公＊▲. ...If you want me to call you that, it's fine.
Ah... I see. It's fine, forget it.
Well？ How about it？ Something like this.
I knew it. You like this kind of thing.
(Since I've got the chance, let me go for it...)
How's that？ Falling for me all over again？
Geez, so happy about it. Cute▼
(Since I've got the chance, let me go for it...)
Is that a yes？ It is, right？
I see, so that's your play...
(Maybe it's about time I tried calling ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ something different...？)
Yeah. If you want to call me that, it's okay.
You don't have to be embarrassed！
That's not it. I really... can't.
(Maybe it's about time I tried calling ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ something different...？)
All right, I'll give you permission.
Haha, you liked it？ It's good, right？
(Maybe it's about time I tried calling ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ something different...？)
Okay. Try calling me that once more？
I'd like a different name. So, okay？
Hmm, well, since it's your request...
But no, after all. I really don't like it.
